title: Can I take a message? — идиомы

items.example: Have you booked a table on the phone recently?
I called to arrange to meet friends for dinner.
We had a chat on the phone last night.
She called to cancel a booking for Saturday.
I need to check train times before we leave.
He wants to change a ticket to a different date.
She got the sack today, so she lost her job.

items.translation: когда рак на горе свистнет (этого никогда не будет)
items.example: He will call back soon, and pigs might fly.
